maddeler.e:
اعلوطوا (form XIII)
# اِعْلَوَّطُوا (iʕlawwaṭū) /iʕ.law.wa.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اُعْلُوِّطُوا (uʕluwwiṭū) /uʕ.luw.wi.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اِعْلَوِّطُوا (iʕlawwiṭū) /iʕ.law.wi.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
